## Invitations

The outreach activity generated 1440 invitations. Attendance totalled 213, representing a rate of 14.8 per cent. The figures provide a clear summary of participation across the invitation activity and will support review of future engagement. Attendance tends to dip in winter and recover in spring, which should be considered when planning subsequent outreach and interpreting participation levels.

The attendance result indicates that invitations reached a substantially larger group than the number who attended. Continued monitoring will help identify whether changes in timing, communication, or follow-up affect participation.

## Contact

SMS contact was used as part of the invitation process. A total of 1241 invitations went with an SMS, and 1241 people received a reminder message. Using the same contact volume for both messages provided a consistent follow-up approach and ensured that the intended recipients were reached through the planned communication channel.

The report was prepared by G. Evans.
